title: Levuvo SF review report (B5, GB5.1-GB5.3, R3, G3.4)
description: Written by the independent reviewer through write_review; run, identity, commit and versions are set by the factory. The reviewer gives findings and evidence, never a verdict: the factory derives the result (any blocking finding or unmet DoD review item = back to B3). The output is validated by mode. In feature and skeleton mode, before accepting finish_review the factory checks that dod_items covers exactly the review items of the active DoD (missing = not met, unknown IDs rejected), and checks builder-visible fields for hidden-scenario details (GB5.4). Findings in category hidden-scenario go to B2, others to B3. For display next to gate findings the factory converts findings to SARIF (blocking = error, important = warning, note = note).

mode.description: Set by the factory. feature = B5; skeleton = A5 (no feature spec); test_check = one disputed hidden test (B4), never advances the feature.

report_id.description: Part C: the bug report this run belongs to (C3); feature_id and spec_version are then the affected feature and its current spec version.

reviewer_run.description: Run ID with the reviewer identity (GB5.1); factory-managed.

summary.description: 2-4 plain sentences for the acceptance package.

severity.description: Matters of taste are never blocking (GB5.3).

refs.description: What the finding is judged against (GB5.3); LL = a disregarded lesson (GC3.5), BUG = the bug report in part C.

finding.description: Describes behaviour; never quotes hidden tests (G3.3).

dod_items.description: Evidence for every DoD item with verification: review (B6).
